name: A Right to Rule
detailed_description:
A Right To Rule is a single-developer indie project—a richly detailed isometric medieval strategy game focused on economic depth and faction dynamics. Forge your legacy through politics, trade, and war as you take control of a struggling region and guide it to power.

Every region on the map features a living economy and distinct population, trading with neighbors and reacting to your rule. As the local lord, you must tax, build, and govern—shaping your territories into prosperous cities or watching them fall into ruin. Each region is home to five key factions: peasantry, merchants, clergy, nobility, and outlaws. Balancing loyalty, fear, and favor among these groups is essential to maintaining power—and to undermining your rivals.

Use cards to influence production, diplomacy, and military affairs. Build infrastructure, command armies, and outmaneuver opponents in a world where every class has its own needs, ambitions, and long memories. In A Right To Rule, power is hard-won—and your every decision echoes through a kingdom on the edge of change.
